_documentation.purpose: Editions of the NetSec Training School (the COST Training School deliverable, run as the Early-Career Scholars Summer School / ECS³). Drives two modules on summer-school.html (+ FR + DE) via assets/js/training-school.js, renderer-light: the forward-looking 'Next call' module and the 'Editions' archive. The rich prose sections (About, Taking part, heritage) stay hand-authored in the page.

schema.status: 'past' | 'announced' | 'call-open'. 'past' renders in the archive with no calendar. 'announced'/'call-open' render the Next-call module; the Add-to-calendar affordance shows only when a real start date is present (an announced-but-undated edition shows 'To be announced' and no calendar).
schema.city: string or {en, fr, de} map, or 'To be announced'.
schema.host: host institution, as a string or {en, fr, de} map, or 'To be announced'.
schema.dates: human dates, as a string or {en, fr, de} map, or 'To be announced'.
schema.start: optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Presence gates the calendar affordance + links the events.json .ics.
schema.ics: optional calendar slug under /calendar/<slug>.ics (only meaningful with a start date).
schema.deadline: optional human application-deadline, as a string or {en, fr, de} map.
schema.coordinators: optional array of { name, affiliation, member_id? } — member_id deep-links to the directory.
schema.topics: optional array of themes covered, each a string or {en, fr, de} map. Rendered on the next-call card and the edition archive.
schema.photos: optional array of { src, alt } for the edition gallery; the renderer omits any src that 404s.
schema.summary: optional one-paragraph blurb for the edition card, as a string or {en, fr, de} map.

_documentation.note: Photos for 2026 live under assets/images/summer-school/2026/. Add new editions by appending a record; flip an upcoming edition's status + fill start/ics when it is announced.

summary.en: The 2027 school runs alongside the European Security Studies Conference on 10 and 11 June. Applicants send a motivation letter, a CV of at most two pages and a 500-word abstract of their research proposal to ecs.netsec@eiss-europa.com.
summary.fr: L'édition 2027 se tient en parallèle de la European Security Studies Conference, les 10 et 11 juin. Les candidat·es envoient une lettre de motivation, un CV de deux pages au plus et un résumé de 500 mots de leur projet de recherche à ecs.netsec@eiss-europa.com.
summary.de: Die Ausgabe 2027 findet parallel zur European Security Studies Conference am 10. und 11. Juni statt. Bewerber·innen senden ein Motivationsschreiben, einen Lebenslauf von höchstens zwei Seiten und eine Zusammenfassung ihres Forschungsvorhabens von 500 Wörtern an ecs.netsec@eiss-europa.com.

editions.summary: The first NetSec Training School ran over three days at Stockholm University, immediately before the European Security Studies Conference, with fifteen funded PhD students joining a faculty of senior scholars for individualised feedback and mentorship.
